description: Search documented eruptions for an Alaska volcano by volcano_id (from geodiva.volcano_list), a specific eruption_id, or a start/end date range (years or ISO dates, including negative/BCE years for prehistoric eruptions). Returns eruption name, narrative description, and start/end date fields. Data: geodiva.avo.alaska.edu, no auth required, US Government public domain.

edate_end.description: Eruption end-date range upper bound — must be paired with edate_start

edate_start.description: Eruption end-date range lower bound — must be paired with edate_end

eruption_id.description: Specific eruption record ID to retrieve, e.g. 4111

sdate_end.description: Eruption start-date range upper bound — must be paired with sdate_start, e.g. "2020-12-31"

sdate_start.description: Eruption start-date range lower bound — must be paired with sdate_end, e.g. "2000-01-01"

volcano_id.description: GeoDIVA volcano ID to list eruptions for, e.g. "ak52" (from geodiva.volcano_list)

name: geodiva.geology.eruption_search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: GeoDIVA Eruption History Search
